item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Supreme Court, by eight votes to three, declared unconstitutional the decree transferring the Guardia Nacional’s administrative and operational control to Sedena, holding that it emptied the constitutional requirement of civil attachment; the ruling also invalidated Sedena’s role in proposing the Guard’s commander.
